logline: Thrown into the castle's subterranean wet cells as Catherine threatens to burn her mother's herbarium and frame her for witchcraft, Juliana breaks down in isolation before swearing that they will never take Alexander from her.
continuity_notes: Follows directly from Episode 28 where Rupert ordered the guards to drag Juliana down to the wet cells while Catherine seized her mother's herbarium.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: High angle tracking shot descending a spiral stone staircase illuminated by flickering wall torches and damp, glistening masonry.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: Dripping water echoes hollowly against stone steps alongside the shuffling scuffle of boots.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tracking shot facing two stern uniform guards hauling a struggling Juliana down the dark corridor by her arms.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana resists furiously, her feet stumbling on the wet flagstones as the guards forcibly propel her forward.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium low-angle shot of Catherine standing regally under an arched stone doorway, clutching the leather-bound herbarium.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight close-up of Juliana's tearful face as she reaches an arm out toward Catherine in anguish.

segments.label: JULIANA (Desperate, Weeping)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Catherine! Please! That book is my mother's only legacy!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot from behind Catherine as she stands motionless, watching Juliana being dragged away.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana turning her head back toward Catherine, screaming through tears.

segments.label: JULIANA (Pleading, Agonized)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: It contains years of her work! Her knowledge! Everything she left me!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Full shot of Catherine turning gracefully on the dungeon steps, holding the book loosely at her side.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up pushing in on Catherine as she presents the worn botanical book with both gloved hands.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Mocking, Condescending)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Your mother's little book of weeds?

segments.label: CATHERINE (Cruel, Smug)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: You still call this a legacy?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana held firmly between the guards, glaring back with fierce defiance.

segments.label: JULIANA (Defiant, Furious)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: It is medicine!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Catherine smiling condescendingly.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Smooth, Patronizing)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Of course.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Overhead close-up of Catherine's gloved fingers flipping through the herbarium's delicate, hand-drawn floral remedies and annotations.

segments.label: CATHERINE (O.S.) (Disdainful, Calculating)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Roots. Leaves. Powders. Strange mixtures written in a dead woman's hand.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Catherine tucking the book under her arm, her eyes glinting with malicious intent.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Icy, Threatening)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: The magistrate will call it witchcraft.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana lunging against the guard's grip, her teeth bared in indignation.

segments.label: JULIANA (Furious, Shouted)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: You know that is a lie!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Catherine lifting her chin arrogantly against the stone backdrop.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Calm, Sinister)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: I know exactly what I need him to believe.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Juliana thrashing frantically against the two guards.

segments.label: JULIANA (Screaming, Desperate)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: You cannot just destroy it!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight close-up of Catherine's eyes narrowing into an icy, venomous gaze.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Whispered, Malicious)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: I can burn it.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana's stricken expression, her eyes widening in horror.

segments.label: CATHERINE (O.S.) (Chilling, Relentless)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: And when they find your corpse at the end of the rope...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Side close-up of Catherine leaning slightly forward, her voice low and merciless.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Cruel, Resolute)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: ...no one will remember what was written inside.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana screaming back in raw outrage.

segments.label: JULIANA (Enraged, Defiant)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: You are doing this because I saved the Duchess!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium low-angle shot of Catherine standing rigid in her silk gown, contempt etched across her features.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Scornful, Arrogant)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: I am doing this because women like you forget their place.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Quick pan from Juliana's apron up to Catherine's face.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Cold, Venomous)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: You were cast out once.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up on Catherine's smiling lips and cold blue eyes.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Menacing)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: You should have stayed forgotten.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana raising her chin, unwavering pride breaking through her tears.

segments.label: JULIANA (Steely, Resolute)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: My husband will find me.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Catherine letting out a scornful laugh, tilting her head.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Scoffing, Amused)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Your scarred soldier?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Catherine's face hardening into sharp mockery.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Derisive, Biting)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: What exactly do you think a penniless veteran can do against Ashbrook?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot as the guard clamps a heavy hand on Juliana's shoulder, shoving her forward.

segments.label: GUARD (Gruff, Dismissive)
segments.speaker: GUARD
segments.text: Move along, girl.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide shot tracking behind the guards as they march Juliana down the vaulted, puddle-strewn corridor toward the heavy iron cell door.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide shot inside the pitch-dark cell as the heavy iron door swings open.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The guards shove Juliana violently into the cell; she falls hard onto all fours across the cold, wet stone floor.

segments.label: JULIANA (Crying Out, Broken)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Please!

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: The heavy iron door slams shut with a deafening metallic thud, and the massive exterior bolt grates locked.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Static shot of the locked iron door, deadlocked in total isolation.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Juliana kneeling on the floor, clutching her chest as hyperventilation overtakes her.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana trembles uncontrollably, her fingers digging into the collar of her rustic dress as terror washes over her.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up of Juliana's tear-drenched face crumpling in overwhelming grief.

segments.label: JULIANA (Sobbing, Heartbroken)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Mother...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot as Juliana pushes herself off the wet stone floor and dashes toward the barred wicket of the heavy door.

segments.label: JULIANA (Desperate, Shouting)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: I have done nothing!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight profile close-up of Juliana gripping the rusted iron bars, screaming out into the empty stone corridor.

segments.label: JULIANA (Screaming, Hysterical)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: I saved her! I healed her!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot from inside the cell as Juliana pounds her fists rhythmically against the reinforced iron door.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: Muffled, dull metallic clanging reverberates as Juliana hammers against the iron door.

segments.label: JULIANA (Shouting in Anguish)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: I saved the Duchess!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Juliana slumping down against the rough stone wall, pulling her knees to her chest while weeping softly.

segments.label: JULIANA (V.O.) (Sorrowful, Wounded)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: They took my mother's ledger...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Front medium shot of Juliana slowly rising to her feet, crossing her arms firmly across her chest as her tears stop and her expression hardens into steely resolve.

segments.label: JULIANA (V.O.) (Quiet Resolve, Unbreakable)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: They took her locket. But they will not take Alexander from me.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the dungeon's massive iron portcullis bars dropping down with finality.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: A heavy iron portcullis crashes down with a massive echoing bang.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle shot looking up at Juliana standing dignified in the center of the damp dungeon cell, gazing upward toward the overhead grate where faint beams of moonlight filter down, cutting sharply to black.
